items.text: Develop and implement embedded firmware for digitally controlled power conversion systems, including DC-DC converters, inverters, and AC-DC converters.
Responsible for control algorithm design, system integration, testing, and optimization to achieve high efficiency, reliability, and compliance with performance requirements.
Team player, work cross functionally with different teams to verify firmware meets system needs and requirements.
Participate in design validation testing, engineering builds (Proto/EVT/DVT/PVT), and system integration testing using ATE systems.
Minimum 4 years of engineering experience in embedded firmware development for battery systems (BBU, UPS), SMPS, Pure-Sine Inverters and related industries.
Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems and real-time control firmware.
Solid experience with MCU/DSP platforms such as TI C2000, NXP MCX-N, or STM32 series.
Experience using MATLAB/Simulink or PLECS for control system modeling and design.
Experience developing BMS firmware for multi-cell or high voltage battery packs.
Experience debugging hardware and firmware interaction issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers (e.g., JTAG/SWD).
Experience developing common communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, and CANBUS for real-time data exchange, telemetry, and communication protocol implementation.
Experience developing bootloaders and firmware upgrade mechanisms.
Strong understanding of power topologies (buck, boost, half/full-bridge, LLC, PFC, inverter) and battery systems.
Requires flexibility with working hours and business travel depending on projects demands.

description.text:
To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we're looking to add a Sr. Staff/Staff Firmware Design Engineer located in Taiwan Taipei Wugu Site. Firmware Design Engineer performs the responsibility for firmware design in Tier 1 CSP customer's CBU/PSU Projects request.
Here is a glimpse of what you'll do
1. Develop and implement embedded firmware for digitally controlled power conversion systems, including DC-DC converters, inverters, and AC-DC converters.
2. Responsible for control algorithm design, system integration, testing, and optimization to achieve high efficiency, reliability, and compliance with performance requirements.
3. Team player, work cross functionally with different teams to verify firmware meets system needs and requirements.
4. Participate in design validation testing, engineering builds (Proto/EVT/DVT/PVT), and system integration testing using ATE systems.
Here is some of what you'll need:
1. Minimum 4 years of engineering experience in embedded firmware development for battery systems (BBU, UPS), SMPS, Pure-Sine Inverters and related industries.
2. Proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems and real-time control firmware.
3. Solid experience with MCU/DSP platforms such as TI C2000, NXP MCX-N, or STM32 series.
4. Experience using MATLAB/Simulink or PLECS for control system modeling and design.
5. Experience developing BMS firmware for multi-cell or high voltage battery packs.
6. Experience debugging hardware and firmware interaction issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers (e.g., JTAG/SWD).
7. Experience developing common communication interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, and CANBUS for real-time data exchange, telemetry, and communication protocol implementation.
8. Experience developing bootloaders and firmware upgrade mechanisms.
9. Strong understanding of power topologies (buck, boost, half/full-bridge, LLC, PFC, inverter) and battery systems.
10. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written).
11. Problem solving and organizational skills.
12. Requires flexibility with working hours and business travel depending on projects demands.
